system.description:
Primal Chain

Ninjutsu you cast that gain the Chain keyword, gain the associated Chain effect, regardless of the Chain rank used.

Earth Release: If your jutsu requires an attack, on a hit the affected creature makes a Strength saving throw. If your jutsu already requires a saving throw, then apply this effect on a failed save; On a failed save you magnify their weight as they succumb to the intense gravity. Reduce the number of attacks they can make and the number of creatures they can target with their next jutsu or attack by 1 (Minimum 1). This penalty increases by 1 (2 reduced attacks/targets) at 10th and again at 17th level (3 reduced attacks/targets at 17th)

Wind Release: If your jutsu requires an attack, on a hit the affected creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. If your jutsu already requires a saving throw, then apply this effect on a failed save; On a failed save you release a burst of blinding wind overcoming them as they thrown 30 feet, fall prone and suffer half the result of 1d12 as a penalty to their next attack before the beginning of your next turn. This increases to their next two attacks at 10th and next three attacks at 17th level.

Fire Release: If your jutsu requires an attack, on a hit the affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw. If your jutsu already requires a saving throw, then apply this effect on a failed save; On a failed save you release a wave of flaming chakra overwhelming them as you drain them of their immediate fighting potential. They suffer a 1d12 penalty to their next damage roll. This increases to 2d12 at 10th and 3d12 at 17th level.

Water Release: If your jutsu requires an attack, on a hit the affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw. If your jutsu already requires a saving throw, then apply this effect on a failed save; On a failed save you release a torrent of waves breaking your enemy and disorienting them as the next attack targeting them, until the end of your next turn, can be made at advantage. This increases to the next two attacks at 10th and the next three attacks at 17th level.

Lightning Release: If your jutsu requires an attack, on a hit the affected creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. If your jutsu already requires a saving throw, then apply this effect on a failed save; On a failed save the affected creature is electrocuted and the next time they attempt to use their Action or Bonus Action or at least 5 feet of movement they must roll a 1d12, losing the attempted action or movement if they roll 10 or more. The result needed to lose the attempted movement or action decreases to 8 or more at 10th level and 6 or more at 17th level.

The Weapon specialist who trains in the Primal Weapon Doctrine, infuses their attacks with their natural born Nature Release, releasing powerful elemental strikes with each attack.
